channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Aaron Nesmith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Aaron Nesmith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Aaron Nesmith
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Pacers' $100K fine for violating the Player Participation Policy:

“During the interview (with the NBA), they also asked if we considered medicating (Aaron Nesmith) to play in a game when we were 30 games under .500.”

Rick Carlisle on Aaron Nesmith, Feb 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Aaron Nesmith
item.description:
“I've said it many times, but every NBA team wants to have a guy like Aaron Nesmith. His effort is unbelievable. His energy. His attitude, all of those things. I know he's going to show up every day and be the same guy. I think that's what I appreciate about him the most.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Aaron Nesmith, Jun 16, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Myles Turner on Aaron Nesmith
item.description:
Pacers center Myles Turner said.

“Landing on your back like that is not fun, but it sparked a big play for us. That's just not new for him. It's very on par for what Aaron Nesmith brings to our team. Just a hard-nosed guy. I think he does an amazing job of just selling out. He'll go out there and just put his body, his life on the line for the team.”

Myles Turner on Aaron Nesmith, May 3, 2025. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Aaron Nesmith
item.description:
“What he brings doesn't always show up on the scoresheet. Some people say, like, they're willing to die for this. Double-A is willing to die for this. He gives it his all every night and I think every team in the NBA wants a guy like Aaron Nesmith. Every team who wins big and ultimately wins it all always has a guy like Aaron Nesmith.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Aaron Nesmith, May 3, 2025. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Aaron Nesmith
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on Aaron Nesmith:

“I’m proud of his growth and what he’s been able to do.”

Jaylen Brown on Aaron Nesmith, May 20, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam, Jarace Walker, Aaron Nesmith, Bennedict Mathurin, Ben Sheppard
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Carlisle:

“Aaron Nesmith and Pascal Siakam are great examples for Jarace Walker, Ben Sheppard, Ben Mathurin.... Pascal has earned his position in this league, two-time All-Star, two-time All-NBA. Aaron Nesmith has earned his spot on our team.”

Rick Carlisle on Pascal Siakam, Jarace Walker, Aaron Nesmith, Bennedict Mathurin, Ben Sheppard, Jan 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Josh Richardson, Aaron Nesmith
item.description:
Danny Ainge:

“I think Brad’s done a great job. I think that getting Dennis Schroder in here this summer was huge. And Josh Richardson is really playing well for the team right now, especially lately after a little bit of a slow start, but he’s playing really well. I think that the team -- we have seen what Aaron Nesmith and Payton [Pritchard] could do, they showed us what they could do last year. But there's just so much depth on the team, especially in those wing and outside-shooter positions, that it's tough.”

Danny Ainge on Josh Richardson, Aaron Nesmith, Dec 9, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Aaron Nesmith
item.description:
Keith Smith:Jaylen Brown on Aaron Nesmith:

“Great kid. He plays hard. He works his ass off. I love having him on the floor. He makes mistakes sometimes, but he makes them going 100%.He can shoot the ball, he guards, he sacrifices his body. I love having him out there.”

Jaylen Brown on Aaron Nesmith, Apr 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Aaron Nesmith
item.description:
Chris Grenham:Brad Stevens on Aaron Nesmith:

“He'll get an opportunity, there's no doubt about that.... I think the key is to prepare for those and just do what he's doing. His work ethic is excellent. He's in the gym first every day.”

Brad Stevens on Aaron Nesmith, Feb 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.
